age-calculator.title: Age Calculator | Your Exact Age in Years, Months and Days | Mufeed Tools
age-calculator.description: Enter a date of birth to see your exact age in years, months, days, weeks and hours, on today's date or any date you choose, plus days to your next birthday. Free.
age-calculator.lead: Pick your date of birth to see your age in years, months and days. You can also work out your age on a specific date, such as a job or admission deadline.
age-calculator.lblRef: Calculate age on (today's date is filled in)
age-calculator.note: Results follow the Gregorian calendar. For official forms, check the age rule and the cut-off date in the notice.
how: If you need your age on a particular date (for example an application deadline), change the second box; otherwise leave today's date.
You will see years, months, days, total days, weeks, hours and the days left until your next birthday.

faq.q: How do I find my age on a job application cut-off date?
faq.a: Enter your date of birth, then choose the cut-off date from the notice in the second box. The tool gives your age on that date.
Yes. Days are counted on the real calendar, so leap years are included automatically.

faq.q: How is age in Hijri years worked out?
faq.a: The tool divides your total days by the average lunar year (about 354.37 days) for an approximate figure. It is an estimate, not an exact Hijri birth date.

faq.q: Is my date of birth saved?
faq.a: No. It is used inside your browser only.

whatsapp-direct.title: WhatsApp Direct Chat: Message Without Saving a Number | Mufeed Tools
whatsapp-direct.description: Start a WhatsApp chat without saving the number. Choose the country code, type the number and message, or create and copy a wa.me link. Free.
whatsapp-direct.h1: WhatsApp Direct Chat and Link Generator
whatsapp-direct.lead: Choose the country code, type the number and, if you like, a ready message. Open the chat or copy its link.
whatsapp-direct.note: We do not save the number or message; the chat opens straight in WhatsApp on your device. This site is not affiliated with WhatsApp.
how: Choose the country, for example Pakistan (+92).
Type the number without the leading zero. If you type it, the tool removes it for you.
Write a message if you want one.
Press “Open chat” or copy the link.

faq.a: An official WhatsApp link that opens a chat with a given number, optionally with a ready message. The tool builds it for you once you enter the number.

faq.q: Do I need to save the number?
faq.a: No. The chat opens without adding the number to your contacts.

faq.q: How do I write the number?
faq.a: Pick the country code and type the number without the leading zero, or type it in full international form starting with + or 00.

faq.q: Why does the chat not open?
faq.a: The number may not have a WhatsApp account, or the country code may be wrong.
